commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jose Munuera who sees an offensive foul.
90+5' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90+4' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90+3' Yellow card. Donny van de Beek (Girona) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Jose Gaya (Valencia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Munuera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
88' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Diego Lopez and he is replaced by Fran Perez (Valencia).
88' Substitution. Pepelu (Valencia) on for Enzo Barrenechea.
87' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

87' A sweet pass finds Yaser Asprilla (Girona) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Giorgi Mamardashvili is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
85' Michel prepares a substitution. Arnaut Danjuma is replaced by Portu (Girona).
85' Viktor Tsygankov goes off the pitch and Yaser Asprilla (Girona) comes on.
84' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

84' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) and Arnaut Danjuma have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.

82' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the left post.
81' The resulting corner from Javi Guerra (Valencia) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
81' Javi Guerra (Valencia) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
80' The attendance is 10262.

76' 11:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
72' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' Andre Almeida will be replaced by Luis Rioja (Valencia).
70' Carlos Corberan has decided to make a change. Rafa Mir (Valencia) replaces Umar Sadiq.
68' A long pass, executed by Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
67' The game has begun to heat up. Jose Gaya (Valencia) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.

64' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) bravely launches himself at a cross from Miguel Gutierrez and gives Giorgi Mamardashvili no chance with a close-range bullet header into the right of the goal. 1:1.
60' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
59' Substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) has come on for Bojan Miovski.
59' Here is a change. Arthur Melo is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Oriol Romeu (Girona).

58' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Dimitri Foulquier, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Diego Lopez (Valencia), who beats Paulo Gazzaniga with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

55' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
54' Jose Gaya (Valencia) will take the free kick.
54' Yangel Herrera (Girona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
53' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Jose Munuera couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Yangel Herrera (Girona) and blew his whistle.
52' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

52' Arnau Martinez (Girona) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. The ball goes out of play and Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

49' Bojan Miovski (Girona) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.

42' Great teamplay by Valencia as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
40' PENALTY APPEAL after Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

38' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
37' Ivan Martin doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Donny van de Beek (Girona) comes onto the pitch to replace him.

33' Arthur Melo (Girona) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
33' The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.

32' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Girona force a corner. They send men into the box.
31' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
27' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the corner but it's cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
26' Girona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

25' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance. The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.
25' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) produces a poor lofted pass into the penalty box. His attempt is easily thwarted by the defence.
25' Jose Munuera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia).
23' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the bottom right corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga keeps it out with an amazing save.
22' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
19' A poor mid-range free-kick by Andre Almeida (Valencia) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
18' The free kick will be taken by Andre Almeida (Valencia).
18' Yangel Herrera (Girona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
16' Valencia are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
15' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
15' Diego Lopez (Valencia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
13' What a big chance! Bojan Miovski (Girona) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
11' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) attempts to release Umar Sadiq with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
6' A lofted cross from Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
5' Andre Almeida (Valencia) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
